doctorMode.title: Doctor Mode
doctorMode.dashboardSubtitle: Bitácora, doctor linking, and shared readings
doctorMode.subtitle: Log your readings, link with a doctor when you choose, and share only the categories you allow. The app never labels values as high, low, or dangerous.

gate.title: Doctor access required
gate.needVerifiedPlan: Doctor Mode patient data is available only with an active doctor plan and a verified cédula. Unverified doctors cannot see patient data.

onboarding.title: Doctor profile
onboarding.hint: Enter your professional details. Verification uses an automated cédula check (mock provider in Phase 1).
onboarding.name: Full name
onboarding.required: Name, specialty, and cédula are required.

linking.title: Patient ↔ doctor linking
linking.hubHint: Create a short-lived invite or enter a code. You confirm the link and control every consent toggle (all off by default).
linking.enterDoctorHint: Enter the code your doctor shared. You will confirm before any data is shared.
linking.enterPatientHint: Enter the code your patient shared. You must be verified and entitled.
linking.linked: Link confirmed. Consent categories start OFF.
linking.invalid: Invalid or already used invite code.
linking.doctorNotReady: Doctor must have a verified cédula and an active doctor plan.
linking.consentHint: Each category is OFF by default. Turn on only what you want this doctor to see. Revoking cuts access immediately.
linking.revokeMessage: This doctor will immediately lose access to your shared data.

bitacora.title: Bitácora
bitacora.hubHint: Quick log for blood pressure, glucose, weight, and symptoms — raw values only.
bitacora.disclaimer: Values are stored as entered. The app does not interpret them as normal, high, low, or dangerous.
bitacora.chartsHint: Simple plots of your numbers — no reference bands or risk colors.

doctor.hubHint: Requires doctor plan + verified cédula. Unverified doctors cannot see patient data.
doctor.noPatients: No linked patients with active consent yet.
doctor.rawOnly: Shared readings as raw values only — no clinical labels.
doctor.medsSharedHint: Medication list is shared (read-only). Full med sync arrives with live consent filters in a later pass.
doctor.adherenceSharedHint: Reminder adherence is shared when available from the patient's reminders.

alerts.title: Alert limits
alerts.hint: Notify me only when a new reading crosses a limit I set. Alerts never say a value is high, low, or dangerous.
alerts.pushBody: A reading crossed a limit you set. Open the app for details.
alerts.crossedLimitDetail: A reading crossed a limit you set.

patientHub.title: Bitácora & doctors
patientHub.dashboardSubtitle: Log readings and control what your doctor can see
patientHub.subtitle: Log your readings and link with a doctor when you choose. Doctors use the separate AuricRX for Doctors app.
patientHub.auditHint: Recent link, consent, and doctor-read events.
patientHub.doctorAppNote: Your doctor views shared data in AuricRX for Doctors (com.auricrx.doctors), not inside this patient app.
